BiblicalUsage: This se'ar is hair too, and Daniel uses it to show what the fire could not do and what pride did. The three men came out of the furnace with the fire having no power on their bodies, nor was a hair of their head singed. And Nebuchadnezzar, driven from men, grew hairs like eagles' feathers until he knew that the Most High rules.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the same hair proves both things: the fire cannot touch those God keeps, and pride will grow wild until a man bows.
